_doc: Entity-link-precision gold sample (t/3125 -> t/3202 harness). Observed = real system-produced claim entity_refs, CL-labelled. Constructed = synthetic detector-validation negatives; they MUST NOT be pooled into the observed precision number.
method: Claim-side entity_refs sampled from summaries/*.json (t/3124 pass), stratified over method=exact|alias, deduped by (surface,ref,kind); each labelled genuine/spurious by checking the surface string against its claim text and the entity name/aliases. Adversarial FP hunt (ambiguous surfaces, <=4-char tokens, over-general aliases) found none.
provenance_note: CL-agent expert labels; PI/human relabelling upgrades to human-validated.
